messages:
noah (partnerships): Kickoff idea: SI Onramp Launchpad = 10-day sandbox + certification lite + marketplace quick-listing. Goal: reduce time-to-first-demo for SIs from 3w -> 5d. Thoughts?

tess (marketplace): Love it. If we have a YAML template + 1-click asset (quickstart link) we can push listings live same day they finish the sandbox. Need product copy + logos.

omar (hw-partner): HW team can loan 6 nodes for staggered access windows. We'll provide an engineer for one office hour per week. Need lead time for image build.

giu (solutions): Practically, cohort size should be 8-12. Also suggest two parallel tracks: "Deploy" (infra, autoscale, fallbacks) and "Integrate" (app + prompts + evals).

rachel (training): I'll design a "certificate lite" — 3 checkpoints: setup, demo, and a short practical (deploy a model + run eval). Badge gets minted on pass. Can we keep the practical <30 min?

ivy (devex): UX: ephemeral tokens + guided notebook. Propose provisioning flow: 1) SI signs form, 2) ops creates sandbox, 3) script runs: `./si-onramp bootstrap --org acme --days 10`. We can capture logs to help support.

ben (ops): We can automate provisioning but need an allowlist CSV and cost center tag. Sandbox accounts can be billing-disabled and capped at X GPU hours. QA window is 48h.

noah (partnerships): @omar can you confirm node types and preemptibility? SIs will need consistent perf for demos.

omar (hw-partner): We'll reserve 3 stable nodes (non-preemptible) and 3 burst nodes. Stable nodes are A100-80GB equiv. Confirmed.

tess (marketplace): Marketplace fields request: partner_name, offering_short, supported_models, deployment_modes, verified_benchmarks_link, contact_email, quickstart_url. We should also add a "recommended SLO" field.

giu (solutions): Recommended SLO example: p95 inference <300ms @ 512 tokens on dedicated pool. Add note about fallback to hosted small-cap model if capacity limited.

rachel (training): For assessment scoring, pass criteria = all checkpoints pass OR demo + one automated test failing optional. We should allow a remediation attempt within 7 days.

ivy (devex): Notebook will include a perf-check cell and a tiny harness:```python
# run perf check
from perf import run
run(prompt_set='si_onramp_small', seq=512, warmup=5)
```
Support will auto-collect the `run` output.

ben (ops): Ops action: create provisioning Lambda + allowlist process. If we can't finish automation before kickoff, we'll do manual onboarding for first two cohorts.

noah (partnerships): Timeline proposal: prep week (content + infra) = 1 week, run two overlapping cohorts over 2 weeks, then cut marketplace listings in week 4. Kickoff this Monday (1795550600) for prep. Good?

giu (solutions): Tight but doable if training and devex lock drafts by Thu.

rachel (training): I'll post module outlines by Wed and mock assessment by Thu.

omar (hw-partner): Image build ETA Wed EOD.

tess (marketplace): I'll make the YAML template and a 1-paragraph PR blurb for marketing. Share copy by Fri.

ivy (devex): Will repo the notebook and onboarding script in `dev-tools/si-onramp` and include `README.md`.

ben (ops): I'll sketch the allowlist CSV format: `org_name,contact_email,start_ts,end_ts,cost_center_tag`. Need input from partnerships on SIs.

announce-bot: Reminder scheduled: partnerships/si-onramp-prep -> reminder at 2026-04-07T09:00Z

noah (partnerships): Quick question: should we require SIs to sign an NDA for access to sample workloads? Some customers will be sensitive.

giu (solutions): Yes, require an NDA for customer-provided workloads. Use a checkbox on the intake form.

rachel (training): Also recommend creating a short "grading rubric" doc so SIs know expectations; will attach to cert page.

ivy (devex): UX nit: add a "replay" link to the perf harness output so SIs can share demo artifacts with customers.

omar (hw-partner): We'll provide a templated quote for joint announcements. Partner marketing can co-sign.

tess (marketplace): Final ask: add a quick compatibility matrix of models + quantization used in the sandbox. That helps listing consumers.

noah (partnerships): Nice. Action owners: Rachel = cert + rubric (due Thu), Ivy = notebook + script (due Thu), Ben = provisioning plan (due Thu), Omar = image + quote (due Wed), Tess = YAML + blurb (due Fri), Giu = SI invite list (due Wed). Prep sync Mon 30m. Thanks all :raised_hands:
